facts.text: Through the Bryan Nursing Access Program, students complete their first two years tuition-free at Chadron, Peru, or Wayne State College before transferring to Bryan with a guaranteed spot in the BSN program.

sources.title: Bryan Nursing Access Program - Bryan College of Health Sciences
sources.quote: Free tuition for your first two years at a Nebraska State College Guaranteed spot in Bryan's nursing program Earn Your BSN and start your career as a nurse
